info.name: Giga Workspace API
info.description:
Client Services Workspace API (NestJS).

Phases covered: 0–9 (staff workspace + Phase 9 client self portfolio /me/*).
Roadmap: 10 client cases, 11 notifications, 12 facial ID, 13 hardening — see docs/API.md.
Base path: {{baseUrl}} = http://localhost:3001/api/v1

Seed password: Workspace@123 (must include upper, number, special).

Client signup flow:
1) Client register → Cognito emails code
2) Client confirm with code → user + pending client_link
3) Client login works after email confirm
4) Staff: List verifications → Verify approve

Phase 9: Client portal — login client.5 (approved) for /me/*; client.1 expect 403 until approved.

Login → Superadmin saves {{accessToken}}. Login → Ayesha saves {{ayeshaToken}}.

Live ERP view row count via src_projects.
Nest JWT when AUTH_PROVIDER=nest; Cognito access/id/refresh when cognito. Saves accessToken (+ refreshToken if present).
AUTH_PROVIDER=cognito only. Use session from a NEW_PASSWORD_REQUIRED login response.
AUTH_PROVIDER=cognito only.
AUTH_PROVIDER=cognito only. Sends Cognito reset code via pool email/SMS.
AUTH_PROVIDER=cognito only.
Missing uppercase + special → 400 with Cognito/Nest password requirements message.
Matches src_clients by CNIC/phone. Creates pending_client_signups and sends Cognito email code. Password must meet pool policy.
Set {{signupCode}} from Cognito email. Creates workspace user (role=client) + client_links verification_status=pending. Client may login after this.
Works after Client confirm (email verified). Staff approve is separate from login.
Uses collection bearer {{accessToken}}. Run Login — Superadmin first.
Run Login — Hamza first. MustChangePasswordGuard blocks /me when flag is set.
WARNING: changes Hamza's DB password. Re-seed or restore hash afterwards if you need Workspace@123 again.
Stateless JWT — client should discard the token after this.
Requires superadmin | department_admin | employee. Run Login — Superadmin first.
Run Login — Client first. RolesGuard rejects client.
Superadmin only. Keeps FIN active (safe smoke).
From New, Resolved is illegal → 422.
Seed FIN case; CCS admin should get 403. Run Organization → Login Ayesha first if needed.
Staff queue. Saves first pending id to {{clientLinkId}} for Verify — approve.
Staff approve. Requires superadmin | department_admin. Run List verifications first so {{clientLinkId}} is a pending link.
Mutates verification_status. Prefer Verify — approve for the happy path.
Filter sales by ERP project id.

Creates workspace case (Outstanding Query). Run List outstanding first. Mutates cases table.
